Subject: FNOL - Water Damage Loss - Policy CPP-2847-001 - Meridian Manufacturing

Submitting FNOL for our insured Meridian Manufacturing Inc located at 1247 Industrial Blvd, Canton OH. Policy CPP-2847-001, EOP 03/15/25.
